question: What contemplative visualization grants the power to shake the triple world?
premises: One should always contemplate something smoke-colored.
This contemplation is the prescribed act.
The result is the power to shake the triple world.
inference: By always contemplating a smoke-colored form, one may shake the triple world.
uncertainties: the smoke-colored object of contemplation is not explicitly named
plain_english: Always contemplating a smoke-colored form, one may shake the triple world, O beloved.
